Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionLove Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a narrative-driven spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and the moments that shape a lifetime. Now elderly, Riku looks through an old photo album with his grandchildren and tells them the story of his life with Lily. Some memories have begun to fade, appearing in grayscale throughout the album. By finding the differences hidden within each illustrated scene, you help Riku reconstruct those memories and restore the pages to full color. Follow Riku and Lily across 21 chapters, from their younger years through adulthood, family life, and old age. Although they are very different from one another, their story shows how love can grow alongside those differences. Play at your own pace alone or with someone close to you in local co-op, and revisit completed chapters anytime through Riku’s memory album.Show morePublished byLucky Raccoon GamesDeveloped byLucky Raccoon Games & Enchant GamesPlay withPCXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SHandheldCapabilitiesXbox local co-op (2-2)4K Ultra HDHDR10Single player60 fps+120 fpsOptimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryConsole Keyboard & MouseXbox achievementsXbox presenceXbox cloud savesXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
